items.title: AI Rumpelstiltskin "Tip Toein' In My Jordans" takes over the internet
items.summary: An AI-generated, '80s-fantasy-style clip of a creepy Rumpelstiltskin-like imp dancing for a crying princess, set to Riff Raff's "Tip Toe Wing In My Jawwdinz," hit its mainstream peak on October 7, when NBC News and Know Your Meme both explained it. The footage looked so real that many people went hunting for the old movie it supposedly came from. Users swapped in everyone from Asmongold to Wednesday Addams and paired it with captions like sneaking downstairs at 2am. One early X post had reached 9.8 million views in five days.
